title: SciSpace Pricing 2026: Plans, Credits and Costs
summary: SciSpace pricing runs $20, $90, or $200 monthly for three paid plans, with annual discounts reducing rates to $12, $70, or $160 respectively.
body_markdown:
## The case against SciSpace's paid plan


The best argument against buying is that free tools and an assistant you already pay for cover most paper reading. For anyone who reads less than weekly, that argument wins.


### Why free SciSpace tiers may be enough


Free tiers, including SciSpace's own, will summarize a paper, answer a question about a section, and explain a dense paragraph in plain words.


If you already subscribe to a general assistant, it does much the same work at a similar monthly price, and it also drafts your emails and fixes your spreadsheet.


Then there's the checking problem. An AI summary can misstate what a paper found, flip a caveat, or attach a conclusion to the wrong experiment.


**So you open the paper anyway** . If you have to verify every summary, the skeptic asks, what exactly did you pay for?


If you open a paper now and then, to understand one result or prepare for a meeting, the free tier and your existing assistant are enough.


The checking point also stands in full: no plan removes the need to read the passage a claim rests on. Anyone buying SciSpace expecting to skip that step is buying the wrong thing.


### Where free SciSpace plans fall short


One paper at a time is how the objection prices things. A weekly reader isn't reading one paper. They're screening many, comparing findings across them, and pulling out the same details again and again.


That's where free tiers hit their caps and a general assistant becomes a chat window with no memory of your reading list.


When the tool points you to the passage it drew from, checking also costs less. You verify a claim in seconds instead of hunting for it.


The paid plan earns its price by making the checking you were always going to do cheaper, and only readers who do it every week do enough of it to notice.
